channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: $500 ACA check is coming from Trump: Are you one of the Americans eligible?
item.description: “For years, the Biden administration overcharged you to fund the operation of HealthCare.gov,” Trump said. “That money belongs to hard-working Americans, not the Government, and now I'm returning it to you.”

item.title: IDF video: Child allegedly used as ‘human shield’ to move weapons in Gaza
item.description: According to the Israeli military, its troops operating in central Gaza identified a militant using the child to move weapons into a civilian home.

item.title: Pennsylvania Reports Fifth Measles Death in Widening Crisis
item.description: Pennsylvania has reported its fifth measles-associated death this year, as the US continues to suffer through its worst outbreak in decades.

item.title: Trump calls Iraq exit a ‘victory’ over ISIS: Why June 2027 is now crucial for Baghdad
item.description: For years, the presence of US forces provided an external military counterweight to Iran-backed armed groups. With American troops now gone, Baghdad has greater responsibility for managing the balance between its own security institutions and powerful militias.

item.title: US Senate blocks data center power-cost bill amid election-year clash
item.description: The measure required 60 votes to advance but received only 57, with 43 senators voting against it

item.title: US leaves Iraq, Houthis advance: Challenges for the Middle East as it prepares for a post-American security era
item.description: The US has ended its military mission in Iraq, closing a major chapter of its post-9/11 Middle East presence. As regional threats grow, Saudi Arabia has turned to Pakistan and Turkey while its ties UAE are under the scanner, signaling a shift toward regional security alliances.

item.title: Petroleum Act draft: Licence breaches may no longer be criminal, but repeat violations could cost ₹5 crore
item.description: The draft Petroleum (Amendment) Bill, 2026 proposes decriminalising licence breaches, with civil penalties of up to ₹2.5 crore for a first violation and ₹5 crore for repeat breaches, while tougher punishment is proposed for serious offences.

item.title: Govt lowers windfall tax on diesel, ATF exports amid West Asia tensions
item.description: The rate of special additional excise duty (SAED) along with road and infrastructure cess on the export of diesel will now be ₹16 per litre.

item.title: FTC launches probe into OpenAI, Anthropic over ‘rogue’ AI agents as concerns grow over safety
item.description: A senior FTC official said the agency plans to issue formal demands for information and compel testimony from executives at major AI developers, including OpenAI, Anthropic

item.title: US inflation comes in below expectations in August amid high energy prices linked to Iran war
item.description: US inflation in August rose less than expected, potentially easing pressure on the Federal Reserve for rate hike. Consumer spending increased despite rising energy prices linked to the US-Israel conflict. While a rate hike remains possible later this year, current market expectations have softened.

item.title: Netanyahu hugs passenger who saved pilot, tackled attacker aboard FlyDubai flight | Watch video
item.description: FlyDubai flight FZ1073, initially transmitted squawk code 7700, an international emergency signal, before sending code 7500, which indicates a hijacking or unlawful interference, as per Times of Israel. Reportedly, an altercation broke out in the cockpit of the flight.

item.title: Can AI dull human brain? Doctor warns of impact on memory, language and recall
item.description: Amid the AI rat race, a neurologist warns against over-relying on AI tools in daily lives. Here's how it may impact children and adults.

item.title: FlyDubai scare: 'Crash' attempt, pilot stabbing and a 17,000-ft plunge | What we know so far
item.description: For now, flydubai has confirmed the cockpit altercation and safe emergency landing, while the more serious allegations about an attempted crash and the motive remain under investigation.

item.title: Harry and Meghan’s $14.5 million California mansion: What they plan to do with it after UK move?
item.description: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex have been living in the UK since late August after moving their family to the Cotswolds area outside London.

item.title: Monsoon rainfall in 2026 fourth-lowest since 2001, says IMD
item.description: Southwest monsoon rainfall stands at 87% of the long-period average.

item.title: LPU violent protests: PS5s, phones, laptops, Prada perfumes and cash looted in Uni Mall; but one thing goes untouched
item.description: Following protests at LPU over sexual assault allegations, looting ensued at Uni Mall. While some videos depict student involvement, claims suggest outsiders were responsible.&nbsp;

item.title: Who is Smit Machchhar, the Indian FlyDubai captain stabbed during mid-air cockpit clash?
item.description: A FlyDubai flight from the UAE to Israel made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after its pilots fought mid-air, with one allegedly stabbing the other. Indian captain Smit Machchhar was injured, while the other pilot was arrested after reportedly attempting to crash the plane.

item.title: Traders' associations call off ‘No UPI Day’ protest on 2 October after assurance from Finance Minister Sitharaman
item.description: Traders have canceled the 'No UPI Day' protest on 2 October, against the 0.4% MDR charge on merchant payments, following assurances from Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Wednesday.&nbsp;

item.title: PSU employee pays ₹10,000 rent for 2BHK in Assam, ₹20,000 on protein-rich food, internet goes crazy: ‘Aao Mumbai’
item.description: A woman has gone viral on Instagram after she revealed her monthly expense of ₹45,000. She is based out of Dibrugarh, Assam while working for Indian Oil.

item.title: Fiscal deficit widens as capex, subsidy spending rise in first five months
item.description: According to the latest monthly accounts released by the Controller General of Accounts (CGA) on Wednesday, the fiscal deficit stood at ₹7.10 trillion, or 41.9% of the full-year budget estimate, during April-August of FY27. This deficit was 38.1% of the annual target a year ago.&nbsp;

item.title: PM Modi speaks with Trump: India-US trade, defence, energy and critical tech cooperation reviewed
item.description: In a post on X, PM Modi said the two sides agreed to maintain close engagement to advance the India-US Comprehensive Global Strategic Partnership.

item.title: US EB-5 fees jump: What it means for Indians seeking Green Cards through investment
item.description: The fee increase comes at a significant time for Indian applicants. Demand for EB-5 visas has grown, and India has already faced limits on the number of EB-5 unreserved visas available during the current fiscal year.

item.title: Cabinet approves ₹2.79 trillion for rabi MSPs, green energy, Delhi traffic system
item.description: The approvals include ₹90,962 crore for higher rabi MSPs, ₹1.86 trillion for a green energy corridor and ₹1,790 crore for Delhi’s traffic management system.

item.title: Centre raises MSP for wheat for ‘more than double’ production cost; price now stands at ₹2,610 per quintal
item.description: The agricultural sector has achieved over 4% growth, enhancing farmer welfare and food security. The government raised the MSP for wheat to ₹2,610 for the 2027-28 year.

item.title: Finance ministry to review financial inclusion schemes with PSU bank chiefs on 6 October
item.description: SBI chairman and MDs, CEOs of all public sector banks have been asked to attend the review meeting in person.

item.title: US Midterm Elections 2026: Why President Trump’s powers are at stake as Iran war, economy weigh on voters
item.description: US Midterm Elections 2026: Essentially, the midterms won't decide who occupies the White House. Trump remains president, but the upcoming polls could determine how much room he has to legislate, spend, make appointments and operate without congressional resistance.

item.title: PM DHARA programme: Why India needs a ₹1.86 lakh crore smart-grid push for renewables
item.description: The Union Cabinet approved the ₹1.86 lakh crore PM-DHARA scheme to strengthen intra-state power transmission and evacuate up to 135 GW of renewable energy. It includes 50 GWh of battery storage, with ₹54,082 crore in central support to reduce transmission costs and power prices.

item.title: Russia extends diesel export ban through October amid global fuel crunch: What it means for world energy market
item.description: Russia has extended diesel export restrictions through October to stabilise domestic fuel markets amid rising demand. This follows previous bans and is a response to reduced refining capacity due to conflicts, impacting global fuel supply and prices.

item.title: FlyDubai flight scare: Passengers pray, sing as plane makes emergency landing in Saudi Arabia | Video
item.description: A commercial plane traveling from Dubai to Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia. A video from the plane has now surfaced online from the moment when it made its emergency landing at Tabuk airport on Wednesday.

item.title: Pollution consciousness will spread from Delhi to other states: PM advisor Tarun Kapoor
item.description: Most north Indian cities routinely see bad air quality during winters, says Tarun Kapoor, advisor to Prime Minister Narendra Modi in the PMO.

item.title: FSSAI action at Seven Seas Hotel: Rotten food, blackened oil, cockroaches found; 74 kg of food items destroyed on-site
item.description: FSSAI suspended Seven Seas Hospitality’s licence after a Delhi inspection found severe food-safety violations, including fungal growth and rotten food, degraded oil, poor storage, cockroaches and flies. About 74 kg/litres of spoiled food was destroyed. The hotel was ordered to halt food operations.

item.title: ‘Remove evil, deceitful politicians’: Iran woos US voters ahead of midterms in 25-page letter — what is inside
item.description: Iran’s IRGC has issued a 25-page open letter targeting US voters ahead of the midterm elections, urging them to reject Trump’s policies and politicians it blames for US wars and tensions with Iran.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘Military mission that defeated ISIS’ ends: Why US-led coalition is exiting Iraq after 12 years
item.description: The US-led coalition has formally ended its 12-year military mission in Iraq after defeating the Islamic State as an organised military force. Here’s why the coalition withdrew, what role Iraqi forces will now play and how the exit affects IS remnants and Iran-aligned armed groups.

item.title: Former UP IAS Divya Mittal to join politics — Other prominent bureaucrats who switched sides
item.description: Divya Mittal said her political initiative would be shaped in joint consultation with citizens. She, however, is not the first civil servant to trade administrative files for political campaigns. Check other prominent bureaucrats who switched sides…&nbsp;

item.title: ‘Army has moved into AI’: Maj Gen Anand(Retd) on India’s defence tech, data and self-reliance | Exclusive
item.description: The Indian Army is expanding its use of AI and digital engineering to process data, develop training sets and test defence equipment in virtual environments. Maj Gen Pawan Anand (Retd), Director, CETANB, USI, explains how these technologies could speed up defence development.
